notes: Overlaps IMG_7830 for the 02:53 and 03:49 messages. The 06:54 message is followed by a bulleted signature line 'Ace aka mr. make it rain ♾️ 🤴'; the glyph after 'rain' renders as an infinity/♾️ symbol — I read it as infinity but the exact emoji is small and could be a different symbol. The 15:53 message is a reply to his own earlier 'Right now at #398' GMX post. The GMX rank badge has moved from #398 (previous screenshot, price $6.26) to #378 (this screenshot, price $6.70). 'you've been warned' at the very bottom is partially clipped by the bottom banner but fully legible; it has no timestamp header so its timestamp is null. Note the tension between 'The trend line doesn't work in 2026' here and the trendline-based BTC PLAN chart he posted at 02:05 the same day.
